headline: US Regulators Close United Fidelity Bank in Largest Bank Failure in Two Years
summary: US banking authorities shut down Indiana-based United Fidelity Bank in the largest US bank failure in over two years, with First Citizens acquiring the majority of its deposits and assets.
why: Regional bank failures trigger regulatory assessments regarding commercial real estate exposures, deposit insurance funds, and regional banking sector stability.

impacts.name: First Citizens BancShares
impacts.why: Acquiring deposits and assets from failed regional institutions expands market footprint.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The closure of a regional bank represents the largest such failure in two years, drawing investor focus to financial sector asset quality.
